prerequisites: Knowledge from basic subjects of mechanical engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Assignment of the goals and tasks of Industrial Engineering in a company
Application of planning and control methods
Representation of the links between design, manufacturing and assembly
Mapping of production structures and data
Assessment of lead times and manufacturing costs

syllabus_topics: Goals and structure of work preparation
Interaction of work preparation with upstream and downstream areas
Tasks, activities and planning methods in work planning and control
One-piece production flow, design for production
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the exam must be passed. Successful participation in the practical part of the course is a prerequisite for taking the exam.
